{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "l0rinc",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK and requested structuring tests into a characterization commit first"
    },
    {
      "login": "danielabrozzoni",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK, raised edge-case timeout concerns and suggested a mutation-killing test assertion"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3914749439",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "A peer sending a block already known to the node does not update m_last_block_time, which could lead to a shortened or missing grace period before disconnect",
      "quote": "peerA will be given a shorter post block pong grace, or none at all, if the last new block they sent was more than 1min ago",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3936068956"],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3936068956",
      "settled_by_quote": "I also don't think that this is a real issue in practice, because the original problem exists mostly during IBD"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3917382766",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "A user-initiated ping RPC right before disconnection could reset m_ping_start and postpone disconnecting an unresponsive peer",
      "quote": "When we reach the disconnection check here, m_ping_start will be fresh, and we won't disconnect.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3936100736"],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3936100736",
      "settled_by_quote": "this feels like one of those fringe KI findings that I think don't really need to be addressed"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3991013479",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "The functional test misses checking that peers are not disconnected when the grace period elapses while blocks are still in flight, leaving code mutations undetected",
      "quote": "This way you're checking that we're not disconnecting once the timeout elapsed and the POST_BLOCK_PONG_GRACE period passed if there are still blocks in flight.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4026883848"],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:4026883848",
      "settled_by_quote": "good suggestion - done!"
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5032343334",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Concept ACK",
      "substantive": false
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5068122581",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Concept ACK! I am slowly going through it and learning more about block relay :)",
      "substantive": false
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added participants l0rinc and danielabrozzoni with their Concept ACKs. Tracked three nonblocking concerns from danielabrozzoni concerning two edge-case behaviors and a missing test assertion, all resolved."
}
